reason: I already take magnesium at night at home and I reorder my Toplux or Goli when it runs out. I don't need sachets to go, I'm not switching a routine that works.
objection: I already have a magnesium I trust and take at home, so the carry-anywhere sachet solves a problem I don't have. Why pay $30 to change something that's fine?
would_change_my_mind: A much lower price, like a free or nearly free first box to try, or if my current brand stopped working for me.
